title: Executive Functionning Study for Assessing the Effect of Neurofeedback
description: This dataset comprises EEG recordings from 24 participants performing three executive functioning tasks (N-Back, Sustained Attention to Response Task, and Local Global) collected during the first and last sessions of a neurofeedback intervention study. The data were processed and converted to EEGLAB format, with preprocessing including average referencing, downsampling to 256 Hz, and high-pass filtering at 1 Hz. This resource supports investigation of neurofeedback effects on executive function and working memory performance.
methods_description: EEG data were collected during three cognitive tasks: N-Back (working memory, 1-3 back conditions), Sustained Attention to Response Task (sustained attention, ~10 minutes), and Local Global (selective attention, local/global conditions). Data were acquired at 2048 Hz, then preprocessed including average referencing, downsampling to 256 Hz, and high-pass filtering at 1 Hz using an elliptical non-linear filter. Two sessions were conducted on the first and last days of the neurofeedback experiment.
